CREATIVE PROFILE
Award-winning Senior Brand Designer with 6+ years driving identity redesigns, international omnichannel brand campaigns, and packaging systems for global consumer lifestyle brands. Adept at fusing strategic business goals with striking visual storytelling.
EXPERIENCE
Senior Brand Designer
Lumina Creative Studio (Los Angeles, CA) | 2022 – Present
• Directed visual overhaul of flagship beverage brand, accelerating shelf-pull rate by 34% across 1,800 retail stores.
• Created scalable brand guidelines across print, digital ads, web, and physical retail spaces.
• Managed 4 junior graphic designers, motion animators, and external packaging vendors.
Visual & Packaging Designer
Verve Labs (San Francisco, CA) | 2019 – 2022
• Designed packaging architecture and tactile unboxing experience for 8 direct-to-consumer consumer tech products.
• Produced digital campaign assets generating 12M+ social media impressions.
